criteria.description: Provider-neutral catalog, graph, discussion, assignment, health, and export capabilities expose no Beads types.
criteria.evidence: internal/tracker/capabilities_test.go; internal/tracker/conformance/; WP01 approved; make quality at 8fbb9d9/3611d0b
criteria.notes: Provider-neutral contracts are implemented above both fake and Beads providers.

criteria.description: Automation uses the bounded bd JSON envelope protocol and never parses human-formatted output.
criteria.notes: The qualified tuple is BD_JSON_ENVELOPE=1 and schema_version 1.

criteria.description: Preflight reports and enforces the exact executable version, digest, and protocol schema before mutation.
criteria.notes: Version or schema skew fails closed with typed diagnostics.

criteria.description: Discovery is read-only and performs no initialization, hook installation, or agent-file edits.
criteria.notes: Initialization exists only as an explicit disposable operator action.

criteria.description: All linked worktrees resolve one canonical Beads workspace and divergence refuses mutation.
criteria.notes: Workspace identity is explicit and project-scoped.

criteria.description: The adapter reports the exact capability and safety level of every supported operation.
criteria.evidence: internal/tracker/capabilities_test.go; internal/tracker/beads/adapter.go; WP01 and WP04 approved
criteria.notes: Unsupported guarded update and safe compensation are explicit safe refusals.

criteria.description: Stable WorkID-to-Beads mappings preserve project, schema, and operation provenance.
criteria.notes: Mapping conflicts and malformed metadata fail closed.

criteria.description: Work catalog create, retrieve, and declared update behavior operate through tracker ports.
criteria.notes: Mutation guarantees are constrained to capabilities the provider actually exposes.

criteria.description: Structured criteria retain stable identifiers and metadata across provider round trips.
criteria.notes: Criteria are metadata-backed, not Markdown checkbox authority.

criteria.description: Blocking edges and provider readiness are translated without replacing pinned-graph readiness.
criteria.notes: Provider readiness remains diagnostic only.

criteria.description: Durable comments preserve operation attribution and idempotent replay.
criteria.notes: Comments do not carry review or acceptance authority.

criteria.description: Visible assignment projects ownership without minting execution authority.
criteria.notes: Assignment is not a lease and cannot alter fences or workspace generations.

criteria.description: Content-derived opaque revisions detect provider drift even when timestamps match.
criteria.notes: The revision is an observation token, not provider-side CAS.

criteria.description: Arbitrary read-then-write updates are never represented as atomic compare-and-set.
criteria.notes: Guarded arbitrary update is unsupported for the qualified provider.

criteria.description: Compensation mutates only when attribution is provable; otherwise provider state is preserved.
criteria.notes: Real qualification preserved all 20/20 human-change cases and returned typed safe refusals.

criteria.description: Post-timeout observation classifies replay, retry, conflict, unavailable, and indeterminate outcomes.
criteria.notes: Blind retry is not recommended or performed.

criteria.description: Provider failures use stable typed diagnostic and recovery kinds.
criteria.evidence: internal/tracker/beads/errors_test.go; internal/tracker/beads/inspect_test.go; WP03 and WP04 approved
criteria.notes: Diagnostics cover unavailable, skew, malformed, ambiguous, lock, revision, and attribution cases.

criteria.description: Portable invariants run against fake, dishonest, and real providers according to declared capabilities.
criteria.evidence: internal/tracker/fake/conformance_test.go; internal/scenario/beads_fault_test.go; docs/phase2-evidence/results.md; WP08 and WP09 approved
criteria.notes: The real-server qualification is 11/11; portable and dishonest campaigns retain separate source identities.

criteria.description: Concurrent provider writes use an explicit qualified mode or adapter serialization with documented limits.
criteria.notes: Server mode passed 1,000/1,000 terminal creations with zero collisions or duplicates.

criteria.description: Operators have non-destructive diagnostics, portable export, and separately verified restorable backup workflows.
criteria.evidence: internal/tracker/beads/backup_integration_test.go; README.md; docs/phase2-evidence/results.md; WP09 and WP11 approved
criteria.notes: JSONL interchange is explicitly not described as a restorable backup.

criteria.description: The authority kernel cannot import the Beads adapter or acquire provider workflow semantics.
criteria.notes: The classified adapter tier may name Beads; kernel tiers fail CI if they do.

criteria.description: Every adversarial provider scenario preserves universal local authority invariants.
criteria.notes: Real evidence reports 23 audits and zero authority invariant failures.

criteria.description: Qualification emits strict machine-readable source, provider, schema, mode, census, and verdict evidence.
criteria.notes: Unknown/trailing serialization, dirty source, census, stale marker, and attribution mutants fail closed.

criteria.description: Public documentation accurately records the v1.2.2 JSON CLI boundary and its authority and safety limits.
criteria.notes: Exact command, tuple, link, Mermaid, authority, source, census, export/backup, and checksum checks pass.
